abilities.name: Violet Edge
abilities.text: Once per round, before a Signal or Guile battle/test, add +1.

abilities.name: Glassmere Footwork
abilities.text: Once per round, you may evade one non-boss enemy in an anomaly or mirror sector.

abilities.name: Rift-Flame Hand
abilities.text: After you fail a Signal test, you may discard 1 Route Note to reroll that test.

abilities.name: Courtbreaker Smile
abilities.text: Once per round, after you pass a Guile test against a noble, mirror, or court sector, record 1 Route Note. Weakness: Violet Edge cannot be used on Forge or Command tests.
